claim_boundary: The primitive map summarizes settled checkpoint-level official-gate evidence. Probe maps summarize pilot paired-dose measurements and selector routing coordinates, not model improvements. The PCA is descriptive and does not establish cross-backbone alignment or causal transfer.

visual_encodings.environment_primitive_gate_heatmap: strict four-metric official-gate state; text is selected checkpoint delta PSNR
visual_encodings.environment_probe_psnr_response_heatmap: signed dPSNR/ddose; crossed cells fail the frozen locality threshold
visual_encodings.irg_pca: PCA of per-feature standardized active-r20 response coordinates with unsupported paths masked; color is best current gate-positive primitive
visual_encodings.primitive_probe_affinity_graph: solid edges are active required paths; dashed edges are missing required paths; dotted edges are staged successor axes
